claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (CMV/ASSIST/AutoFlow, PEEP 5, tidal volume ~550 mL), monitoring airway pressures and minute volume.
Wean FiO2 from 40% as tolerated while maintaining SpO2 >92%, reassessing arterial blood gases.
Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 6.8–8.9 g/dL) given consent is documented.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit serially to assess response to transfusion and ongoing blood loss.
Monitor arterial blood pressure closely and maintain mean arterial pressure ≥65 mmHg, adjusting vasopressor (phenylephrine) support as needed.
Continue temporary pacemaker with backup pacing (rate 52 bpm) and monitor rhythm and capture thresholds.
Monitor lactate trend (1.3–3.1 mmol/L) to assess tissue perfusion and resuscitation adequacy.
Check and replete electrolytes (ionized calcium 1.07–1.18 mmol/L, magnesium 2.6 mg/dL, potassium 3.8–4.3 mEq/L) as indicated.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium screening (CAM-ICU) while on propofol infusion.
Provide VTE prophylaxis and continue aspiration precautions with head-of-bed elevation in the intubated patient.
